metadata.question: Did regions of the Pacific Northwest like Dallasport, Washington and Medford, Oregon reach temperatures above 105 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR) maximum 2m air temperature (K) from 2010-01-01 to 2025-01-01 for Dallasport, WA and Medford, OR, with 10 km buffers. If empty, fall back to ERA5 Daily (ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY). 2. Masking strategy: Reanalysis data has no clouds; no masking required. 3. Logic: Compute per-day regional stats (mean and max) via reduceRegion; count days where regional max exceeds 105°F threshold. Validate with pixel counts; handle empty collections (C1), zero valid pixels (C2), null results (C3), and exceptions (D). Answer Yes only if both regions exceeded the threshold at least once. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const dallasport = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.178, 45.609]).buffer(10000); const medford = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.875, 42.326]).buffer(10000); const start = ee.Date('2010-01-01'); const end = ee.Date('2025-01-01'); const band = 'maximum_2m_air_temperature'; const thresholdK = ee.Number(105).subtract(32).multiply(5).divide(9).add(273.15); // 105F in Kelvin // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback let col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate(start, end) .select(band); let size = await col.size().getInfo(); let datasetUsed = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR'; if (size === 0) { const fallback = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY') .filterDate(start, end) .select(band); const sizeFallback = await fallback.size().getInfo(); if (sizeFallback === 0) { console.log(`Images: 0 in both ERA5-LAND and ERA5 for ${start.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()} to ${end.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()}`); console.log('C1'); return; } col = fallback; size = sizeFallback; datasetUsed = 'ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY'; } function kToF(k) { if (k === null || k === undefined) return null; return (k - 273.15) * 9 / 5 + 32; } async function analyzeRegion(name, geom) { const firstImg = ee.Image(col.first()); const pixCount = await ee.Number( firstImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 9000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band) ).getInfo(); if (pixCount === null || pixCount === 0) { return { name, status: 'C2' }; } const colWithStats = col.map(function (img) { const stats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geom, scale: 9000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return img.set({ meanK: stats.get(`${band}_mean`), maxK: stats.get(`${band}_max`) }); }); const daysAbove = await colWithStats.filter(ee.Filter.gt('maxK', thresholdK)).size().getInfo(); const maxOfMaxK = await ee.Number(colWithStats.aggregate_max('maxK')).getInfo(); const maxOfMeanK = await ee.Number(colWithStats.aggregate_max('meanK')).getInfo(); if (maxOfMaxK === null || isNaN(maxOfMaxK) || maxOfMeanK === null || isNaN(maxOfMeanK)) { return { name, status: 'C3' }; } return { name, status: 'OK', pixCount, daysAbove, maxOfMaxF: kToF(maxOfMaxK), maxOfMeanF: kToF(maxOfMeanK), anyOver: daysAbove > 0 }; } console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}, Period: ${start.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()} to ${end.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()}, Images: ${size}`); console.log(`Threshold: 105°F = ${thresholdK.getInfo().toFixed(2)} K`); const resDallas = await analyzeRegion('Dallasport, WA', dallasport); const resMedford = await analyzeRegion('Medford, OR', medford); if (resDallas.status !== 'OK') { console.log(`Dallasport status: ${resDallas.status}`); console.log(resDallas.status); return; } if (resMedford.status !== 'OK') { console.log(`Medford status: ${resMedford.status}`); console.log(resMedford.status); return; } console.log(`Dallasport: Pixels=${resDallas.pixCount}, MaxF_mean=${resDallas.maxOfMeanF.toFixed(1)}, MaxF_px=${resDallas.maxOfMaxF.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`Dallasport Days>105F (max px)=${resDallas.daysAbove}`); console.log(`Medford: Pixels=${resMedford.pixCount}, MaxF_mean=${resMedford.maxOfMeanF.toFixed(1)}, MaxF_px=${resMedford.maxOfMaxF.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`Medford Days>105F (max px)=${resMedford.daysAbove}`); const finalYes = resDallas.anyOver && resMedford.anyOver; console.log(finalYes ? 'A' : 'B'); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 200)}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
